name: opengrow
description: OpenGrow Cloudflare deployment: dashboard, OpenGrow-compatible API, SDK, and short links.

scripts.worker:check: npm run worker:types:reference && npm run worker:typecheck && npm run worker:test && npm run cloudflare:test:services && node scripts/cloudflare-dry-run.mjs --service api --reference --allow-unprovisioned
scripts.billing:typecheck: cd workers/billing && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.runtime.json
scripts.billing:test:runtime: node scripts/cloudflare-config.mjs --service billing --reference --allow-unprovisioned && npx vitest run --config workers/billing/vitest.runtime.config.ts
scripts.billing:test: npm run billing:test:unit && npm run billing:test:runtime && npm run billing:test:config
scripts.billing:types: npm run cloudflare:config:billing:reference && node scripts/cloudflare-types.mjs --service billing --reference --allow-unprovisioned
scripts.billing:check: npm run billing:types && npm run billing:typecheck && npm run billing:test && node scripts/cloudflare-dry-run.mjs --service billing --reference --allow-unprovisioned
scripts.legacy-messaging:typecheck: cd workers/messaging && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.runtime.json
scripts.legacy-messaging:test: npm run legacy-messaging:test:unit && npm run legacy-messaging:test:runtime
scripts.legacy-messaging:check: npm run legacy-messaging:typecheck && npm run legacy-messaging:test && node scripts/cloudflare-legacy-messaging-check.mjs --mode dry-run
scripts.email:test: npm --prefix packages/email-transport test && npm --prefix workers/email test
scripts.email:check: npm run email:types && npm run email:typecheck && npm run email:test && node scripts/cloudflare-dry-run.mjs --service email --reference --allow-unprovisioned
scripts.identity:check: npm run identity:types && npm run identity:typecheck && npm run identity:test && node scripts/cloudflare-dry-run.mjs --service identity --reference --allow-unprovisioned
scripts.files:check: npm run files:types && npm run files:typecheck && npm run files:test && node scripts/cloudflare-dry-run.mjs --service files --reference --allow-unprovisioned
scripts.observability:check: npm run observability:types && npm run observability:typecheck && npm run observability:test && node scripts/cloudflare-dry-run.mjs --service observability --reference --allow-unprovisioned
scripts.mcp:test: npm --prefix workers/mcp test && npm --prefix apps/mcp test
scripts.mcp:check: npm run mcp:types && npm run mcp:typecheck && npm run mcp:test && npm run mcp:build && npm run mcp:lint && npm run mcp:audit && npm run mcp:docker:check && node scripts/cloudflare-dry-run.mjs --service mcp --reference --allow-unprovisioned
scripts.custom-reference:check: npm run custom-reference:typecheck && npm run custom-reference:test
scripts.custom-vocostar:check: npm run custom-vocostar:typecheck && npm run custom-vocostar:test
scripts.modules:lint: for service in app products paywalls dynamic-links support marketing onboardings; do npm --prefix workers/$service run lint --if-present || exit 1; done
scripts.modules:types: for service in app products paywalls dynamic-links support marketing onboardings; do node scripts/cloudflare-types.mjs --service $service --reference --allow-unprovisioned || exit 1; done
scripts.modules:typecheck: for service in app products paywalls dynamic-links support marketing onboardings; do npm --prefix workers/$service run typecheck || exit 1; done
scripts.modules:test: for service in app products paywalls dynamic-links support marketing onboardings; do npm --prefix workers/$service test || exit 1; done
scripts.modules:dry-run: for service in app products paywalls dynamic-links support marketing onboardings; do node scripts/cloudflare-dry-run.mjs --service $service --reference --allow-unprovisioned || exit 1; done
scripts.modules:check: npm run cloudflare:test:services && npm run modules:lint && npm run modules:types && npm run modules:typecheck && npm run modules:test && npm run modules:dry-run
scripts.flutter-purchases:check: node --test scripts/flutter-android-build-contract.test.mjs && cd sdks/flutter && flutter analyze && flutter test
scripts.flutterflow-purchases:check: cd sdks/flutterflow && flutter analyze && flutter test
scripts.flutterflow-messaging:check: cd sdks/flutterflow_messaging && flutter analyze && flutter test
scripts.flutter:check: npm run flutter-purchases:check && npm run flutterflow-purchases:check && npm run flutterflow-messaging:check
scripts.react-native:check: npm run react-native:native-contract:check && npm --prefix sdks/react-native run check
scripts.portable-sdks:check: npm run javascript:check && npm run react-native:check
scripts.cloudflare:test:targets: node --test scripts/backoffice-policy.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-bootstrap.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-worker-shells.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-development-secrets.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-target.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-types-reference.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-deploy-plan.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-domain-plan.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-migration-batch.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-services.test.mjs scripts/configuration-boundaries.test.mjs scripts/custom-worker-check.test.mjs scripts/github-bootstrap.test.mjs scripts/github-deployment-matrix.test.mjs scripts/github-deployment-workflow.test.mjs scripts/github-history-plan.test.mjs scripts/github-readiness.test.mjs scripts/github-reconcile.test.mjs scripts/non-node-security-audit.test.mjs scripts/opengrow-configure-application.test.mjs scripts/opengrow-generate-identity-keyset.test.mjs scripts/opengrow-target-options.test.mjs scripts/platform-readiness.test.mjs scripts/public-routing-gate.test.mjs scripts/vocostar-managed-workers.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-d1-*.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-secret-bundle.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-secret-promote.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-secret-retire.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-secret-inventory.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-secret-preflight.test.mjs scripts/cloudflare-rotate-oauth.test.mjs
scripts.secrets:scan: npm run secrets:scan:history && npm run secrets:scan:workspace
scripts.typecheck: npm run worker:typecheck && npm run billing:typecheck && npm run email:typecheck && npm run identity:typecheck && npm run files:typecheck && npm run observability:typecheck && npm run mcp:typecheck && npm run modules:typecheck && npm run dashboard:typecheck
scripts.test: npm run contracts:test && npm run dashboard:test && npm run worker:test && npm run billing:test && npm run email:test && npm run identity:test && npm run files:test && npm run observability:test && npm run mcp:test && npm run modules:test
scripts.test:e2e:real: cd apps/dashboard && PLAYWRIGHT_REAL_BACKEND=1 npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:all: npm run copy:check && npm run sdk:catalog:check && npm run sdk:catalog:test && npm run sdk:documentation:check && npm run flutterflow:source:test && npm run flutterflow-library:check && npm run flutterflow-applications:check && npm run migration:inventory && npm run migration:inventory:test && npm run cloudflare:test:targets && npm run dashboard:lint && npm run typecheck && npm run custom:check:all && npm run legacy-messaging:check && npm run chatwoot:test && npm run flutter:check && npm run portable-sdks:check && npm run test && npm run module-cutover:test && npm run dashboard:cf-build:reference && npm run worker:check && npm run identity:check && npm run files:check && npm run observability:check && npm run mcp:check && npm run modules:check
